name: watch
description: memory-kit watch: rings a doorbell in the session (idle-safe) when a file the home declares in memory-kit.conf (watch_files) grows or is replaced by other text, never touching the file, and reports, information only, idleness and context growth past the marks the home declares there

home.title: Kit home
home.description: The kit home whose memory-kit.conf declares the doorbells (watch_files) and the report marks (watch_idle_minutes, watch_context_percent). Empty: the folder the session started in, or the nearest one above it with a memory-kit.conf.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the doorbell files are checked for new text and the report checks run. Local file reads only; the watch never empties a file.
